selection_note: The pairwise-focus weight of 0.001 was chosen after inspecting seed 3000 evaluation results. This retest freezes that checkpoint before collecting seed 3200. It is a same-family replication with one newly evaluated page variant, not a blind general benchmark.
success_criterion: On each qualifying evaluation page, the frozen action model must beat both its paired-action swap and the frozen state-only model in weighted error, with the correct action winning at least 70 percent of pairs. Missing page coverage is a failed coverage gate, not a success.
promotion: none; this is synthetic same-family seed/page transfer, not real desktop, safety, or Jev-parity evidence
